name: Yugen Golf City
summary: Yugen Golf City by Yugen Infra exists. RERA number PP1310002501906 is a MahaRERA (Maharashtra) registration for the Garden of Eden plots (~45 acres, 278 plots) at Village Banda, Taluka Sawantwadi, District Sindhudurg, Maharashtra. The developer markets it as 'North Goa' near Mopa, which is misleading; our Maharashtra/Banda location is correct. Wyndham-managed Acqua Front Villas and a Rs 21 L/yr (~Rs 1.75 L/month) rental guarantee are confirmed only by developer and broker material. Prices conflict across sources (Rs 99.9 L vs Rs 1.55 Cr for plots; Rs 3.31-3.59 Cr for villas; 62 vs 70 villas). No independent source supports 'guaranteed ROI' or the 2X return claim.

checks.web: Yugen Golf City, a proposed ~500-acre township by Yugen Infra, with phases Golfer's Paradise and Garden of Eden
checks.note: The '500-acre' figure is a proposal. Only Garden of Eden is RERA registered.

checks.web: Yugen Infra (Yugen Infra Pvt Ltd, Gurgaon-based)

checks.ours: Banda, on NH-66 near the Goa border — next to Manohar International Airport (Mopa), Banda, near Patradevi, Banda (Goa–Maharashtra border, near Mopa), Maharashtra (verify)
checks.web: Village Banda, Taluka Sawantwadi, District Sindhudurg, Maharashtra, on NH-66 about 15 min drive from Mopa airport. The developer and news headlines market it as 'North Goa' / 'near Mopa, Goa'.
checks.note: Our Maharashtra/Banda placement is correct, and the '(verify)' can be dropped. High severity because the developer (yugeninfra.com says 'North Goa') and portals (RealEstateIndia lists it under 'Mopa, Goa') misstate the state. 'Next to' Mopa is overstated: sources say about 15 minutes' drive. Patradevi was not confirmed.

checks.web: PP1310002501906, MahaRERA (Maharashtra), for Garden of Eden (residential plotted, Village Banda, Sawantwadi, Sindhudurg)
checks.note: This is a Maharashtra RERA number, not Goa RERA, and it covers only the Garden of Eden plots, not the whole township, the villas or the studios. The MahaRERA portal itself was not fetched. Construction World calls Garden of Eden 'Phase 2'.

checks.ours: new-launch (source: Developer material: Garden of Eden villa plots RERA-approved and selling; Phase I (Golfer's Paradise) sold out)
checks.web: Garden of Eden MahaRERA-approved and selling; Golfer's Paradise (~30 acres, 151 plots) marked 'Sold Out' on the developer site
checks.note: 'Sold out' comes only from the developer.

checks.web: Acqua Front Villas: expected 2028 (broker listing); no possession date found for the plots

checks.ours: ₹99.9 Lakhs onwards (Garden of Eden plots, 200 sq yd)
checks.web: Rs 49,990 per sq yd (≈Rs 99.98 L for 200 sq yd) per axiomlandbase; developer page says 'Starting at Rs 1.55 Crores' for 300+ sq yd
checks.note: The per-sq-yd rate supports Rs 99.9 L for a 200 sq yd plot. But the developer's own page now starts at Rs 1.55 Cr (300+ sq yd), and our brief records a sales message of Rs 1.35 Cr. The entry price varies with plot size and source.

checks.ours: Garden of Eden — villa plot — 200 sq yd onwards — ₹99.9 Lakhs onwards | Golf Drive — farmhouse plot — 1,300–3,000 sq yd — ₹2.99 Cr onwards | Acqua Front Villa — 390 sq yd onwards — ₹3.59 Cr onwards | Studio — ₹11,490 per sq ft onwards | 1 BHK — ₹11,490 per sq ft onwards | 2 BHK — ₹11,490 per sq ft onwards | Cricket Front Villa — By invitation
checks.web: Garden of Eden plots 200-500 sq yd (developer) or 200-1000 sq yd (broker); Acqua Front Villas: 3 BHK with private pool, ~3,000 sq ft on a 400 sq yd plot, from Rs 3.31 Cr, 62 villas (developer) or 70 villas (broker); Golf Drive Farmhouses (29); Cricket Front Villas (30)
checks.note: The component products are confirmed. The villa starting price varies (Rs 3.31 Cr broker vs our Rs 3.59 Cr; within 15%). The villa count conflicts (62 vs 70). Golf Drive's Rs 2.99 Cr and the Rs 11,490/sq ft studio/1/2 BHK pricing were not found independently.

checks.ours: 500+ acres (proposed township) · Garden of Eden 45 acres
checks.web: Proposed 500-acre township; Garden of Eden ~45 acres (developer), ~180,000 sq m ≈ 44.5 acres (Construction World), 44-55 acres (broker)
checks.note: Only about 45 acres (Garden of Eden) plus ~30 acres (Golfer's Paradise) are documented. The 500 acres is a plan.

checks.web: Garden of Eden: 278 plots; Golfer's Paradise: 151 plots; Acqua Front: 62 or 70 villas
checks.note: We publish no counts. Plot counts are available online.

checks.ours: "Guaranteed monthly rental ₹1,75,000" (Acqua Front Villas) | Wyndham partnership
checks.web: Acqua Front Villas managed by Wyndham (Registry Collection by Wyndham), marketed as pre-leased with a rental guarantee of Rs 21 L per annum (= Rs 1.75 L/month)
checks.note: The amount matches developer and broker material, but no Wyndham announcement or independent news confirms either the tie-up or the guarantee. The developer page says 'pre-leased / Smart Returns' without giving a figure. Treat this as a developer claim.

checks.ours: "High appreciation & ROI guaranteed" | Phase I "sold out in 3 months, giving more than 2X return" | Land rate projected at ₹1,00,000+ per sq yd by 2030
checks.note: No independent source supports a guaranteed ROI, a 2X return, or a Rs 1 lakh/sq yd land rate by 2030. These are unsubstantiated marketing claims. Golfer's Paradise is only shown as 'Sold Out' on the developer site.
